description: This file defines the 'HolidayDecorator' class, which acts as a decorator for the 'Holiday' entity, providing formatted date strings and holiday length descriptions.

classes.name: HolidayDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for the Holiday entity that provides additional presentation logic such as formatted date and holiday length descriptions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with a Holiday object.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Returns the holiday date formatted as a string using the DateTimeHelperTrait.

methods.name: getLengthName
methods.description: Returns a human-readable name for the holiday length, based on a static map in the Holiday class.
